description: The Document Library Browser shows a list of document records the way people expect a file explorer to work: folders on the left, documents in the middle and the details of the chosen document on the right. It works with any table or collection that holds documents - for example contract documents, supplier certificates, a policy library, site-visit photos or attachments on work orders.
features: Folder tree built from folder paths with counts, breadcrumbs
Details pane with metadata and open/download links
Multi-select with bulk actions and outputs for canvas OnChange or flows
A phone layout with a folder drawer and full-width details sheet
